overview_description.description: Venu is a virtual reality software company. Venu develops a 3d virtual trade show or conference platform for event organizers to engage and delight attendees. Their platform allows avatars to walk around in first person view, spontaneously connect to showcase products, and present to a live audience in a life like auditorium via computer or virtual reality headset.
